reason: A DSH plugin that bridges Tencent iLink WeChat messaging with a DSH AI agent, providing streaming conversations, persistent per-contact sessions, file exchange, scheduled messages, and optional public web fetching.

summaries.zh: 通过腾讯 iLink 协议将手机微信接入 DSH AI 助手，支持流式对话、会话持久化、文件收发、定时消息和可选的网页抓取。
summaries.en: Connects WeChat to a DSH AI agent through Tencent’s iLink protocol with streaming conversations, persistent sessions, file exchange, scheduled messages, and optional web fetching.

capabilities: Receives WeChat text, voice, image, and document messages
Sends AI-generated replies and files to WeChat contacts
Stores login credentials and per-contact conversation state
Runs scheduled outbound messages to configured contacts
Optionally fetches public web pages through an MCP server
